description: This file defines the MembershipService class, which provides methods for managing memberships, including CRUD operations, searching, counting, and converting memberships to array format within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: MembershipService
classes.description: Service class for managing membership entities, providing CRUD, search, and utility methods within the OrangeHRM platform.

methods.name: getMembershipDao
methods.description: Lazy initialization and retrieval of the MembershipDao instance used for data access operations.

methods.name: setMembershipDao
methods.description: Sets the MembershipDao instance, allowing dependency injection or manual configuration.

methods.name: saveMembership
methods.description: Persists a Membership entity to the database via the DAO.

methods.name: getMembershipById
methods.description: Retrieves a Membership by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getMembershipByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Membership entity based on its name.

methods.name: getMembershipList
methods.description: Returns a list of memberships filtered by specified search parameters.

methods.name: getMembershipCount
methods.description: Counts the number of memberships matching certain search criteria.

methods.name: deleteMemberships
methods.description: Deletes multiple memberships based on provided IDs.

methods.name: isExistingMembershipName
methods.description: Checks if a membership with a specific name already exists.

methods.name: getMembershipArray
methods.description: Returns all memberships as a normalized array suitable for UI or further processing.
